integrity_statement: All results are proved mathematically in the accompanying document. Finite numerical checks are corroboration only. Previously known Gramian framework and one-node cases are credited.
scientific_limitations: Classical unweighted Hardy space, finitely many fixed distinct unit-circle zeros and finite multiplicities only; O constants depend on geometry. Not a uniform coalescence, weighted-space or finite-degree identity.
title: Additive squared-multiplicity law and Legendre boundary profiles for optimal Hardy approximants
